|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `bearssl`: BearSSL at webcpp::crypto's pin: bearssl_hash.h states constant time for its GHASH implementations alone, not for br_md5_*, br_sha1_*, br_sha224_* to br_sha512_* or br_md5sha1_*.
* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.

`digests::md5_sha1` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::md5`, `digests::sha1`, `digests::sha2_224`, `digests::sha2_256`, `digests::sha2_384`, `digests::sha2_512`, `digests::sha2_512_224` and `digests::sha2_512_256`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
